results.title: Legacy, word-of-mouth-grown operator now under an automation-focused parent
results.closest_fact_claim: Karras describes its technology only as scanning products accurately into the warehouse with system integrations offered, with no specifics on real-time monitoring or deviation alerting.

results.title: Four-city, 25,000-pallet network with no stated real-time monitoring
results.closest_fact_claim: Karras has a combined storage capacity of over 25,000 pallets across Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane warehouses (plus an Adelaide location), offering chilled storage (0 to 4 degrees) and frozen storage (-18 to -24 degrees).
